input.summary: Narrow Section 6.1 exclusivity on the Company to Deerskin Products for 12 months, with automatic termination on HDI performance failure.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we do not accept exclusivity obligations on the Company; as a compromise we have limited Section 6.1 to Deerskin Products for twelve (12) months and made it fall away automatically if HDI misses the launch date in Section 1.6 or its other service or delivery commitments. As drafted the restraint ran for the full (annually renewing) term, covered loosely defined "substantially similar" products, and gave us no performance-based exit.

ops.oldText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
ops.newText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the period of twelve (12) months following the Effective Date, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products, and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet. The restrictions on the Company set forth in this Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically, without notice, penalty or further liability, upon HDI's failure to have the Site fully operational within the period specified in Section 1.6 or upon any other failure by HDI to meet the service levels, delivery dates or other performance obligations set forth in this Agreement.
